summary: @servicetitan/skeleton preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated sibling payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub's oven-sh/bun releases into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and immediately invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB obfuscator.io-style bundle (rotating string-array via MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift()), hex-suffixed identifier names, custom character-decode routine) with a header comment '// @bun @bun-cjs'. The setup.mjs wrapper itself is obfuscated with _0x-prefixed identifiers. A React UI skeleton library has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or a large obfuscated helper, and running the payload under Bun evades Node-focused scanners while granting full filesystem and network access on the installer's host at npm install time. The @servicetitan scope resembles the ServiceTitan organization, consistent with a lookalike/impersonation lure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
